title: Straza check-in request (v1beta1)
description: POST /v1/checkin body. Exactly one of id_token (fresh login), device_token (enrolled device starting a session), or session_token (refresh) is required. v1beta1 (2026-09-09): client added, the calling build's version and commit, recorded on the session. v1beta1: id stabilized, no wire changes from v1alpha3. v1alpha3: device_token added, the long-lived enroll credential; its device binding is authoritative, so device_id is ignored alongside it. v1alpha2: attestation.platform added; managed level verified against the expected-hash registry (SPEC.md).

platform.description: Client GOOS/GOARCH, e.g. linux/amd64; selects platform-scoped registry rows

client.description: The straza client build making the check-in (additive, 2026-09-09): its version stamp and commit. Older clients omit it; the server records it on the session.
